events.verdict: Bailey (UTA) is the last player to touch the ball as he throws an errant pass directly out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Denver.
Chandler (UTA) legally contests Murray's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Johnson (DEN) engages with Konchar (UTA) and the contact is marginal as they move down the lane together on the defensive switch.
Chandler (UTA) makes marginal contact with Murray (DEN), as he moves through the lane.
After the shot attempt by Hardaway Jr. (DEN), the ball avoids touching any of the shot clock apparatus or basket wiring before Jokic (DEN) retrieves the rebound.
Chandler (UTA) directly contests Johnson's (DEN) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Johnson's hand after the release.
Murray (DEN) initiates contact with Harkless' (UTA) arm, which causes Harkless to lose control of the ball.
Harkless (UTA) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Gordon (DEN) after his gather during the driving shot attempt.
Harkless (UTA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly retained by Denver.
Chandler (UTA) momentarily places his hands on Jokic's (DEN) leg and hip as he moves to set the pick, and the contact is marginal.
Konchar (UTA) grasps and quickly releases Murray's (DEN) arm off-ball as the throw-in goes over their heads, and the contact is marginal.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) legally contests Bailey's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
